messages:
Anya R.: Heads-up — I'm stuck at the airport, ETA ~22:20. I won't make the 22:00 warm handoff. Sam T., can you take primary for the first 30m? I'll do a soft takeover as soon as I land.

Sam T.: Yep I can take primary for the first 30. @Lee W. you're still secondary for EU, right?

Lee W.: Yep secondary for EU tonight. I'll be available via phone if anything pops.

ops-bot: FYI — scheduled EU maintenance window starts 22:05 UTC for routing infra. Impact: rolling restart of routing proxies in eu-west-1. Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/maint/2026-03-eu-routing 

Anya R.: Ugh timing. The maintenance may cause transient latency increases while caches rewarm. Important for oncall: watch P50/P95 token latency and model fallback rates.

incident-bot: ALERT: service_latency_eu exceeded threshold (P95 > 2000ms) — auto-triggered page. Incident severity: P2. Thread created: 1794012357

Jamal (SRE): Got the auto-alert. Sam, can you validate whether this is maintenance-related or an unrelated regression? Quick checks: 
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=routing-proxy --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
redis-cli -h kvcache-eu info keyspace
```
If it's maintenance noise we follow runbook section "maintenance-induced latency"; otherwise escalate.

Sam T.: Running checks now. Pod restarts look correlated with the scheduled maint for eu-west-1. KV cache miss rate spiked ~22:06. Looks like rewarm.

Lee W.: Confirming: routing-proxy restarts show 3/8 restarted in a rolling batch. No OOMs, just normal restart. Service fallback to secondary model variant increased to 8% (normal <1%).

Maya (Eng Lead): If customer-facing error rate stays low (<0.5%) we keep as P2 and monitor. If error rate climbs or SLA errors appear, escalate to P1 and page eng leadership + CSMs.

Anya R.: OK — Sam/Lee, action plan while I'm en route:
- Sam: act as primary, keep the bridge open and drive triage for the first 30m.
- Lee: be ready to take primary if Sam needs to hand off.
- Jamal: watch infra metrics and advise on mitigation (KV cache pre-warm, routing rollout pause).
- Ops: notify EU customers if degradation persists beyond 15m.

Sam T.: On it. I'm opening a temporary bridge: https://redwood.zoom/meet/hand-off-1794012345 

Jamal (SRE): Suggest flipping routing rollout to paused and progressively warm key K/Vs. Command to pause rollout (maintenance runbook):
```
./deployer pause --service routing-proxy --region eu-west-1
```
And warming a few hot prefixes:
```
python tools/kv_warm.py --region eu-west-1 --prefixes=prod_hot_1,prod_hot_2
```
I'll start warming now.

Sam T.: Paused the rollout. Warm script kicked off. Watching P95 tail.

incident-bot: NOTE: escalation rules applied — current severity P2. Next escalation: if error_rate_customer > 0.5% OR latency_p95 > 2500ms for 10m -> escalate to P1 and page @Maya (Eng Lead) + oncall-manager.

Lee W.: Quick phone escalation matrix in case paging is needed:
```
1) On-call SRE (pagerduty) -> page audible phone within 2 min
2) Eng Lead (Maya) -> page and call if P1
3) Oncall-manager -> phone + slack DM when >30m unresolved or customer-facing impact
```
(Numbers in vault: /ops/phones)

Sam T.: KV warm completed for top prefixes. P95 dropped from 2200ms -> 480ms over 6 minutes, error rate steady at 0.12%. Looks like the mitigation worked.

Maya (Eng Lead): Good. Keep monitoring for another 10–15m. If metrics hold, close the auto-incident and add notes to the maintenance postmortem: mention timing clash with handoff and consider shifting future maint windows by 30m.

Anya R.: I'm 10m out. If everything is green when I land I'll grab the formal handoff and update the runbook with the warm-warming commands that helped.

Sam T.: Bridge will stay open for handoff. I'll annotate the incident thread and add the checks I ran.

Jamal (SRE): Filing a short RCA pointer: "maintenance-induced KV cache cold start increased model fallback; paused rollout and warmed hot prefixes." I'll attach logs: /logs/infra/1794012345/*.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by Sam T. — severity set to P2 -> mitigated. No customer SLA breaches detected.

Maya (Eng Lead): Thanks team. Post-handoff action items:
- Update runbook: add explicit KV warming steps for routing rollouts.
- Adjust maint window start by +30m to avoid typical handoff window (22:00).
- Ops: draft a 1-paragraph customer note in case we need it for the next similar event.

Anya R.: Got it. I'll add the runbook edits after I land and do the formal handoff in 10. :memo: :airplane:
